claim_boundary: broad synthetic plausibility diagnostic; not named-city, traffic, demand, route-choice, or land-use-evolution validation

compact_ccot.counterevidence_checked: motif concentration, hierarchy imbalance, block repetition, single-seed success, and visual overclaim
compact_ccot.evidence: per-map street, block, hierarchy, land-use, terrain, and compiled-runtime metrics
compact_ccot.falsifier: any empirical or structural failure in the fixed matrix
compact_ccot.inference: overall pass requires every record; aggregate means cannot hide a failure
compact_ccot.question: Do all fixed style/seed maps satisfy both pinned empirical envelopes and frozen structural gates?

metric_definition_notes.circuity: compiled straight-fragment length divided by endpoint distance; a lower-resolution diagnostic, not simplified OSM-edge circuity
metric_definition_notes.maximum_branch_free_corridor_m: sum of contiguous degree-two physical edges whose source streets front developed blocks
metric_definition_notes.motif_metrics: diagnostic only; not used as admission thresholds
metric_definition_notes.street_graph: undirected physical centerlines after planar compilation
